reviews.text:
this is the best eyeliner I have ever had!
it is easy to draw with it and it is waterproof, but it is not oil-proof, so if you have oily skin or even to much sunscreen on, it is kinda easy to wipe it off with your finger, but if you‘re careful or use setting spray, it holds the whole day, I even fell asleep with it on once and it was still 80% good
reviews.zh: 呢個係我用過最好嘅眼線筆！畫起上嚟好容易，而且防水，但係唔防油，所以如果係油性肌或者搽咗太多防曬，用手指都好容易抹甩，不過小心啲或者用定妝噴霧就可以keep到全日，我試過瞓著咗，返起身都仲有80%咁好。

reviews.text: It has excellent waterproof performance and the color is very noticeable. It’s east to apply, and i have repurchased it many times
reviews.zh: 防水表現超卓，顏色好突出。容易上色，我已經回購咗好多次。

reviews.text: First time using it and so far am happy with it. The applicator is smooth and the color is great.
reviews.zh: 第一次用，到目前為止好滿意。掃頭好順滑，顏色好正。

reviews.text: I didn’t know the tip was going to be THIS tiny. It’s so precise and applies very easy. I can create however thick of a line I want. The waterproof aspect is true.
reviews.zh: 我唔知個筆尖會咁細。精準度好高，上色好易。想畫幾粗嘅線都得。防水真係有用。

reviews.text: I love it so much because brush is really thin and it helps me to not ruin and i love the color too it also lasts really long!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意，因為支掃真係好幼，幫到我唔會畫花，顏色我都好鍾意，而且真係好持久！

reviews.text: I really like it. Its easy to use! I chose the clear black, which was lighter than I thought it would be (its basically gray). But it lasts, and it's very buildable, so 2 applications gives me a soft black.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意。好容易用！我揀咗 clear black，淺過我預期（基本上係灰色）。不過佢持久，而且好易疊加，搽兩層就有柔和嘅黑色。

reviews.text: Essentially unusable. Not pigmented and skips (even with storing for several days facing downwards, shaking).
reviews.zh: 基本上用唔到。唔顯色仲會跳色（就算倒轉擺幾日、或者搖過都係咁）。

reviews.text: Great application, great colour. This enhances a beautiful look.
reviews.zh: 上色效果好，顏色靚。用完個樣靚咗。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
